description: Full-text search over ISTAT ATECO 2007/2022 codes starting from the activity DESCRIPTION, in Italian ("fotografo", "sviluppo software", "commercio abbigliamento") instead of the code. Case/accent-insensitive, with stemming and colloquial per-trade aliases; also accepts a code prefix. Use this when the code is NOT known — `lookup_ateco` covers the opposite case (known code → description). Results ordered by relevance. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

q.description: Activity to search for, in Italian (e.g. 'fotografo', 'idraulico', 'consulenza informatica').

query.description: Alias of `q` (search text): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.

section.description: Filter by ATECO section (letter A–U, e.g. J = information and communication services, M = professional activities). Optional.

name: search_ateco
title: Search ATECO by activity
